Links upon links upon links of questions finally come to an end. I know without looking around that only Jeanne and I are left in the theater.

With our plans derailed by that unexpected variable, we wandered onto a small, artificial spring a little out of the way from downtown.
Beaten down by the heat of the afternoon sun, we sat down on a bench facing the pond...
... and, after some time...
... we were silently watching the evening sun sink into the horizon.
Its fading blaze was a red smolder now, gentle to our eyes...
As we rested, our sweat dried and our breathing steadied.
And in the silence born from that moment...
Nothing could deny our existence.
That real sunset we happened upon... not the one we consumed from a can...
